messages.subject: AI and dartRverse
parts:
Hi all. 


Some of you would have discovered the delights of AI for advising on analyses and AI code for planning and executing analyses. These tools know all about dartRverse, and so can be quite useful. To this end, a small group of us have prepared a document on AI and dartRverse. It can be found here http://georges.biomatix.org/storage/app/media/tutorials/Tutorial_2_AI_and_dartRverse.pdf.

This is a fast moving field. Please treat it as a living document. We hope that you enjoy it and find this new set of tools useful (used with appropriate cautions).

Feedback most welcome.

Arthur et al.
